economy.summary: In a July 2026 update, the incumbent said the 2026/27 state budget she voted for delivers on affordability and economic development to keep people, businesses, and jobs in Pennsylvania, and includes a cost-of-living adjustment for retired public employees whose pensions have not kept pace with inflation.
economy.short: Says budget delivers affordability, jobs, and retiree pension COLA.

taxes.summary: Said she voted for the 2026/27 state budget without raising taxes, describing it as a blueprint for a more affordable Pennsylvania that supports students, workers, seniors, veterans, small businesses, and communities.
taxes.short: Voted for 2026/27 state budget without raising taxes.

abortion.summary: Is a cosponsor of House Bill 1640, which would amend state law to provide for protection of reproductive health services records in rules of evidence.
abortion.short: Cosponsored bill to protect reproductive health services records.

education.summary: Sponsored House Bill 2425, which passed the House unanimously and would create a Career and Technical Education Curriculum Modernization Grant Program; she said career and technical education gives students a direct pathway to good-paying jobs and invests in the workforce pipeline.
education.short: Sponsored bill funding career and technical education modernization.

energy.summary: Sponsored House Bill 1260, which passed the House and would require new warehouses and distribution centers to be built solar-ready and provide a tax credit for existing ones to retrofit; she said it would increase Pennsylvania's share of renewable electricity, create jobs, and lower utility bills.
energy.short: Sponsored bill requiring solar-ready warehouses to expand renewables.

economy.summary: On his 2024 State Senate campaign issues page, Vasquez said he would combat inflation to make everyday items more affordable, and support policies that help job creators grow and attract new jobs, plus job-training and re-training programs for local workers. His 2026 House campaign website is no longer active.
economy.short: Supports combating inflation, helping job creators, and job training.

taxes.summary: On his 2024 State Senate campaign issues page, Vasquez said he would restore fiscally conservative policies that protect taxpayers, stop government overspending, and reduce the debt left to future generations. His 2026 House campaign website is no longer active.
taxes.short: Supports protecting taxpayers, cutting spending, and reducing debt.

education.summary: On his 2024 State Senate campaign issues page, Vasquez said he would fight to fund both traditional public education and school choice initiatives, and focus education on basic skills including reading, writing, math, science, and technology. His 2026 House campaign website is no longer active.
education.short: Supports funding public education and school choice initiatives.

healthcare.summary: On his 2024 State Senate campaign issues page, Vasquez said he would use common sense and competition to make healthcare and prescriptions more accessible and affordable, and work with the medical community on preventive health programs to control costs. His 2026 House campaign website is no longer active.
healthcare.short: Supports competition and preventive care to make healthcare affordable.

guns.summary: On his 2024 State Senate campaign issues page, under making communities safe, Vasquez said he would severely punish any criminal who uses a gun, get drugs and drug dealers off the streets, focus on addiction treatment, and support law enforcement. His 2026 House campaign website is no longer active.
guns.short: Supports severely punishing criminals who use guns; backs police.
